# partD decisions (generated by partD_figure.py)

| # | what | detected | rule | rows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | timestamps written two ways: ISO and DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM | 3651 slash rows; 2151 have a first field above 12 (cannot be a month); 1500 are ambiguous, 1382 of which a month-first parse would put on a different day | parse each format with its own explicit format string; slash rows day-first. format='mixed' is never used: it parses every row and silently moves the series | 3651 |
| 2 | sessions = -1 (logger not-available code) | 290 rows; the same rows have orders above sessions (290 rows) | NaN, not zero. orders and revenue on the row are real and kept | 290 |
| 3 | device label in three casings (Mobile / mobile / MOBILE) | value_counts() shows case variants of the same class | lower-case then title-case. Done before the duplicate check, which otherwise fails to see identical hours | 3 |
| 4 | the same hour filed twice | 286 hours appear twice; 286 of them are identical in every field once the device label is normalised | keep the first copy. Only exact copies are dropped; a conflicting pair would have stopped the run | 286 |
| 5 | hours nobody filed | 312 hours on 13 whole days out of 529 days | left absent (NaN in any resample), never filled. Whole missing days are reported, not averaged over | 312 |
| 6 | the extract ends part-way through a month | last filed hour 2025-09-11 23:00:00; 2025-09 has 255 filed hours | the final month is labelled partial and never drawn at full weight | 264 |
| 7 | SKU filed under two sub-categories | 1 SKU (SKU-0127) appears twice with identical values; sku_name AUDI-04 | keep the Audio row (name prefix AUDI matches Audio); drop the Wearables copy | 1 |
| 8 | negative net revenue (returns exceed sales) | 7 SKU rows, total -1.0693 PKR m | kept inside sub-category totals so they reconcile with shares_eight.csv; no negative leaf is drawn; each row listed in partD note | 7 |

Daily rule: a day needs >= 21 of 24 filed hours; 21-23 scaled by 24/filed. Scaled days in analysis: 215; scaling changes a 23-hour day by +4.3%.

Shares vs shares_eight.csv: max deviation 0.24 points (tolerance 0.3).
